patterns.note: Asymmetrical split-screen sections are used frequently, pairing large, impactful imagery with text blocks or smaller image grids, often with contrasting background colors.
Key phrases within large headings are highlighted with a vibrant yellow color against dark backgrounds, creating a strong visual emphasis.
A consistent palette of black, white, a soft pink, and a deep teal-green is used for section backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks and a sophisticated feel.
Content sections reveal by sliding up into the viewport from the bottom as the user scrolls, smoothly replacing the previous content.

The homepage features a diverse range of content categories (e.g., 'Eating and Drinking', 'Business', 'Shopping', 'Sustainability') presented as distinct, visually rich blocks rather than a continuous feed.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section utilizes a split layout, featuring an oversized, bold text block on a dark background contrasted with a large image on a light, muted background, with a specific phrase highlighted in an accent color.

Content sections are structured with an alternating pattern of full-width imagery (sometimes with text overlays) and asymmetrical split-screen layouts, often pairing a dominant image with a concise text block or a grid of smaller images.
The navigation (Home link and hamburger menu) remains fixed at the top right of the viewport, providing persistent access to menu options as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and a distinct yellow highlight for key phrases.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with an airy hero section due to the large typography, transitioning to a more standard density in content grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, asymmetrical split-screen layouts and the sophisticated use of a limited color palette, particularly the vibrant yellow highlight against dark backgrounds. The curated, editorial feel, combined with the dynamic section reveals, makes the content feel premium and engaging.
